imageOptions.hint: Respondents pick one picture. Each option needs a text label (it is also what analytics shows); a picture is optional. {{min}} to {{max}} options.
imageOptions.label: Label of option {{number}}

logo.label: Logo
logo.hint: Shown above the title of the published form. PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 512 KB.

theme.title: Appearance
theme.label: Form appearance
theme.hint: Colors, font and corners of the published form. The application itself is not affected.
theme.colorInvalid: Use a six-digit hex color, for example #4f46e5.

preview.label: Preview of the published form
preview.title: How was your day?
preview.description: This is how your form will look to respondents.

warnings.title: Readability warnings
warnings.textContrast: The text color is hard to read on this background. Aim for a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1.
warnings.primaryContrast: Text on buttons in the primary color is hard to read. Choose a lighter or darker primary color.
warnings.primaryVisibility: The primary color barely stands out from the background, so buttons and selected answers may be hard to see.

responseMode.label: Response mode
responseMode.hint: How respondents will answer the questions

emptyState: Drag an item from the sidebar or use the add buttons to create your first question.

conflictModal.title: The form was changed elsewhere
conflictModal.description: This form has already been saved from another tab or device, so your copy is out of date. Load the latest version? Your unsaved changes will be lost.

leaveModal.title: You have unsaved changes
leaveModal.description: Are you sure you want to leave?

text.minMaxError: Minimum length can't be greater than maximum length

number.minMaxError: Minimum value can't be greater than maximum value
number.sliderRangeError: A slider needs a minimum smaller than the maximum

boolean.hint: 💡 The respondent will see this field in the specified state when opening the form.

options.label: Answer options and default value
options.dropdownDisabledHint: Dropdown is only available for single-choice questions
options.rankingHint: Respondents put all options in their order of preference (2–20 options).

condition.enableLabel: Show only if a condition is met (conditional logic)
condition.noTargetsHint: A display condition can only be added for questions that come after other questions.

file.hint: Respondents can attach PDF, PNG, JPEG, WebP or plain text files, up to {{size}} MB each.

nps.hint: Standard NPS question: 0–10 scale with “Not at all likely” and “Extremely likely” at the ends. Nothing to configure.

matrix.hint: The respondent picks one column in every row. If the question is required, all rows must be answered. 1–30 rows, 2–10 columns.

calculation.formulaHint: A question is written [[like this]]; renaming a question does not break the formula. Numbers use a dot (0.5).
calculation.noQuestions: Add questions above first: a formula reads their answers.

functions.title: Functions
functions.hint: Click a function to insert it

IF.description: Picks one of two values; only the chosen one is calculated

ROUND.description: Rounds half away from zero to the given places (0 to 8)

FLOOR.description: Rounds down to the given places

CEIL.description: Rounds up to the given places

SUM.description: The sum of the numbers (use it for long sums)

COUNT.description: How many options of a multiple choice question are picked

SCORE.description: The points of a choice or yes/no question

LABEL.description: The text of the picked option of a single choice question

display.label: Show to the respondent
display.hidden: No, only for the end screen, rules and exports

emptyAsZero.label: Empty counts as 0
emptyAsZero.hint: An unanswered or hidden question counts as 0 (empty text, no). When off, the result stays empty until every question it uses is answered.

placeholder.label: In the end screen text
placeholder.hint: Paste this where the value should appear.

test.title: Test the formula
test.hint: Enter sample answers to see the result the respondent would get.
test.noInputs: The formula does not read any question.
test.fixFirst: Fix the formula to test it.

evalErrors.OVERFLOW: The number or text is too large
evalErrors.EMPTY_REFERENCE: A question it uses has no answer, and “Empty counts as 0” is off
evalErrors.INVALID_ARGUMENT: A value is not allowed here (for example places must be 0 to 8)

errors.FORMULA_TOO_LONG: The formula is too long (at most 500 characters)
errors.TOO_MANY_NODES: The formula is too complex (at most 200 elements)
errors.DEPTH_LIMIT: The formula is nested too deeply; use SUM(…) instead of a long chain of +
errors.UNEXPECTED_CHARACTER: This character is not allowed in a formula
errors.UNEXPECTED_END: The formula ends too early; something is missing
errors.BAD_NUMBER: This is not a valid number
errors.BAD_STRING: The text in quotes is not valid or not closed
errors.BAD_REFERENCE: Choose a question from the list; a question is written [[like this]]
errors.UNKNOWN_IDENTIFIER: Unknown name. Functions are written with brackets, for example ROUND(…)
errors.ARITY: Wrong number of values for this function
errors.TYPE_MISMATCH: The types do not match (for example a number and a text)
errors.UNKNOWN_REFERENCE: This question does not exist (it may have been deleted)
errors.UNSUPPORTED_REFERENCE: This kind of question cannot be used in a formula (or here)
errors.INVALID_CONFIG: Places after the point must be a whole number from 0 to 8
errors.FORMULA_CYCLE: Calculation fields use each other in a circle
errors.HIDDEN_REFERENCE: A visible calculation cannot use one that is hidden from the respondent
errors.TOO_MANY_CALCULATIONS: A form has at most 30 calculation fields

languages.title: Form languages
languages.mainHint: Questions are written in the main language. Add languages to translate the form; respondents can switch between them.
languages.fallbackHint: Empty fields are shown to respondents in the main language.
languages.nothingToTranslate: There is nothing to translate yet. Add a title or questions in the main language.

fields.minLabel: Label for the start of the scale
fields.maxLabel: Label for the end of the scale

removeModal.title: Remove language “{{language}}”?
removeModal.description: All translations into this language (title, questions and options) will be deleted when you save the form.

welcome.enable: Show a welcome screen before the first question
welcome.title: Title
welcome.titleRequired: Enter a title, otherwise the welcome screen is not saved.

end.enable: Show my own message after the form is submitted
end.textRequired: Enter a message, otherwise the end screen is not saved.
end.redirectHint: Respondents are sent here a few seconds after submitting. Only http:// and https:// addresses work.
end.redirectInvalid: Use a full address that starts with http:// or https://. Anything else is not saved.

rules.title: Result rules
rules.hint: Show a different end screen depending on the answers. Rules are checked from top to bottom and the first one that matches is used. If none matches, the message above (or the standard thank-you) is shown.
rules.textRequired: Enter a message, otherwise this rule is not saved.
rules.valueRequired: Fill in the value of every condition, otherwise this rule is not saved.
rules.broken: This rule uses a question that was deleted or cannot be used in conditions. Fix or remove the rule to save the form.
rules.noQuestions: Add a question that can be used in conditions (not ranking, matrix or file) to create a rule.
rules.noTargets: There is no question left to build this condition on.

scoring.hint: Give points for answers, show the total and a category on the end screen, and send respondents to different end screens by their score. Set the points of each answer in the questions.
scoring.multiHint: Points of all picked options are added up.
scoring.multiplierHint: Points = the answer times the multiplier. Leave it empty or 0 for no points. From -1000 to 1000, up to two decimals.
scoring.numberRange: Set both the minimum and the maximum of this number to give it points: without them the best possible score is unknown.
scoring.categoriesHint: A name for a range of totals, for example 0-30 Beginner. Both ends are included and ranges must not overlap.
scoring.placeholdersHint: In the text of an end screen you can use {{score}}, {{maxScore}}, {{percent}} (the number only, write the % sign yourself) and {{category}}.

issues.incomplete: Fill in the name and both ends, otherwise this category is not saved.
issues.overlap: This range overlaps an earlier category.

errors.categories: Fix the result categories: a range runs backwards or overlaps another.

quotas.title: Quotas
quotas.hint: Limit how many completed responses a group of respondents can give, for example 50 answers from one city. When a group is full, only people from that group are turned away; the survey stays open for everyone else.
quotas.name: Name
quotas.message: Message for respondents who are turned away
quotas.messagePlaceholder: Leave empty for the standard text
quotas.messageHint: Shown only to people the quota turns away. It is not translated: write it in the language of your respondents.
quotas.recountNote: Saving a different condition counts the responses again.
quotas.recountHint: Count the responses again from scratch, for example after responses were removed
quotas.valueRequired: Fill in the value of every condition before saving.
quotas.broken: This quota uses a question that was deleted or cannot be used in conditions. Change the condition, or delete the quota to be able to save the form.
quotas.noQuestions: Save a question that can be used in conditions (not ranking, matrix or file) to create a quota.
quotas.noTargets: There is no question left to build this condition on.

deleteModal.title: Delete the quota "{{name}}"?
deleteModal.description: Respondents of this group will no longer be limited. Responses already collected stay.

closing.title: Closing the survey
closing.label: Closing
closing.hint: The survey stops accepting responses at the date, after the maximum number of responses, or whichever comes first.
closing.dateHint: In your time zone. Leave empty for no closing date.
closing.closedByDate: The closing date has passed: the survey no longer accepts responses.
closing.closedByLimit: The maximum number of responses has been reached: the survey no longer accepts responses.
closing.pastDateHint: Choose a later date or clear it to reopen.

header.previewPublished: Open the published form in a new tab
header.previewRestart: Restart the preview from the first question

sidebar.title: Questions
sidebar.empty: No questions yet. Add the first one below.

preview.title: Live preview
preview.session: Preview session · test answers only, nothing is saved
preview.hiddenByLogic: The selected question is hidden by its condition with the current preview answers.
preview.empty: Add a question to see the preview.
preview.finishedText: In the published form this sends the answers. Here nothing was sent or saved.

inspector.title: Question settings
inspector.empty: Select a question to edit its settings.
inspector.typeLocked: The type cannot be changed once the form has responses.

translations.title: Translations
translations.manage: Add or remove languages in Settings

deleteModal.title: Delete this question?
deleteModal.description: The question and its answer options are removed from the form.
deleteModal.withDependents: These questions are shown only depending on this one: {{list}}. If you delete it, their visibility condition is removed and they will always be shown.

moveBlocked.title: This move would break a condition
moveBlocked.description: A condition can only look at an earlier question. After this move the condition of these questions would point at a later one: {{list}}. Change those conditions first, or move the question elsewhere.

typeModal.title: Change the question type?
typeModal.description: The title, description, required state and condition are kept. The settings specific to the old type (options, ranges, rows) are replaced with the defaults of the new type.

testLogic.title: Test logic
testLogic.description: Pick answers to the questions that conditions depend on and see which questions would be shown. Nothing is saved.
testLogic.noConditions: No question has a condition yet, so every question is always shown.

demoLimit: Demo limit: up to {{demoMaxQuestions}} questions per form
